definitions.explanation: A short sleep during the daytime, typically in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：noentry⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{昼寝|ひるね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a short nap after lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{昼寝|ひるね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Babies take a nap every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昼寝|ひるね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: On holidays, I spend my time relaxing and taking naps.

notes:
{昼寝|ひるね} specifically refers to sleeping during the day, particularly after lunch.

Common expressions:
- {昼寝|ひるね}をする (to take a nap)
- {昼寝|ひるね}から{起|お}きる (to wake up from a nap)

Related terms:
- うたた{寝|ね} (dozing off unintentionally)
- {仮眠|かみん} (short sleep, power nap - more formal)
- シエスタ (siesta - loanword)

Cultural note:
Short naps after lunch are becoming more accepted in Japanese workplaces, with some companies providing nap rooms to improve productivity.
